parsed.rationale: All eight participating records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on CGImage spread across test files (ArtworkServiceTests.swift, ArtworkFetcherTests.swift, NowPlayingServiceTests.swift), a production source file (MultisourceArtworkService.swift), and an app-layer file (NowPlayingInfoCenterManager.swift) in three distinct packages (Artwork, AppServices, app:iOS). Every record carries empty fields_or_signature lists and no name, so there is no shared member surface to extract or unify. The structural_evidence block is entirely null (no Jaccard score, no shared field count, no shared ancestor), meaning the pipeline surfaced these solely on the basis of the CGImage type name appearing in extension declarations across files. The coincidence is purely nominal — CGImage is a system framework type being extended in multiple unrelated contexts — and no refactor action is warranted.
